cohort: Women who delivered after 24 completed weeks at Obst. & Gynae Unit II and Unit of Pediatric Medicine, Chandka Medical College hospital Larkana from January 1, 2012 to December 31, 2012.
finding: The perinatal mortality rate was 98/1,000 live births, with prolonged and obstructed labor (30%) and antepartum hemorrhage (18%) being the most prevalent causes.
